# online-metrix.net
> Online Metrix provides device identification, fraud detection, and risk assessment services used in digital transaction flows.

This site appears to host the Online Metrix service and related integration resources used by merchants and partners for collecting device data and supporting fraud screening workflows.

## Core Site
- [Online Metrix Home](https://www.online-metrix.net/): Entry point for the Online Metrix device profiling and fraud prevention service.
- [Main Index](https://www.online-metrix.net/index): Primary landing page for the Online Metrix web application.
- [Device Profiling Endpoint](https://www.online-metrix.net/fp/): Hosted fingerprinting path used during device data collection flows.

## Device Profiling
- [Fingerprint Collection](https://www.online-metrix.net/fp/tags): JavaScript and tag-based device profiling resources for browser integrations.
- [Profiling Assets](https://www.online-metrix.net/fp/clear.png): Tracking asset commonly used in transparent device profiling requests.
- [Profiling Transport](https://www.online-metrix.net/fp/3rdparty): Third-party collection path supporting embedded profiling and partner integrations.

## Integration Endpoints
- [Collector Endpoint](https://www.online-metrix.net/fp/collect): Server endpoint for receiving browser and device profiling data.
- [Session Initialization](https://www.online-metrix.net/fp/init): Initialization path for starting a profiling session before transaction evaluation.
- [Callback Receiver](https://www.online-metrix.net/fp/callback): Callback-style endpoint used in asynchronous profiling and partner workflows.

## Browser Resources
- [JavaScript Tag Loader](https://www.online-metrix.net/fp/tags.js): Script resource used to embed Online Metrix profiling in web pages.
- [Iframe Profiling Resource](https://www.online-metrix.net/fp/frame): Embedded frame resource for browser-based device identification collection.
- [Pixel Resource](https://www.online-metrix.net/fp/clear.png): Minimal image asset used to trigger passive profiling requests.

## Operational Paths
- [Health Check](https://www.online-metrix.net/status): Service status-style endpoint for operational monitoring and availability checks.
- [Error Path](https://www.online-metrix.net/error): Generic error handling path for failed requests or invalid integrations.
- [Support Contact](https://www.online-metrix.net/contact): Contact path for operational or integration-related inquiries.

## Related Access
- [Root Domain](https://www.online-metrix.net): Canonical domain for Online Metrix-hosted profiling services.
- [WWW Host](https://www.online-metrix.net/): Standard HTTPS host serving Online Metrix resources.
- [Secure Access](https://www.online-metrix.net/index): Secure browser-accessible entry page for the service.
